project.description: The chart project, or a project with a helm target from the chart generator, to add the dependency to.
project.x-prompt: Provide the project to add the dependency to

chartProject.description: A chart project in this workspace to depend on. It is added as a file:// dependency at its current version, instead of chartName, chartVersion and repository.

repository.description: URL of the repository (https://, http://, oci:// or file://). Must not contain credentials.

repositoryName.description: Name of the repository for `helm repo add`. Needed for https:// and http:// repositories; oci:// and file:// ones are used directly.

format.description: Deprecated, has no effect. Files are now always formatted; use `skipFormat` to opt out.
format.x-deprecated: Files are now always formatted. Use `skipFormat` to opt out.
